item.title: Creating a Résumé in Doom
item.description:
Crafting an effective Résumé

My current résumé looks professional and lays out all the information I need to convey to potential employers. I made it with a LaTeX template that I’ve modified over the years to suit my needs. This format allows me to comment out information like employers from years ago that I don’t want to include, skills that aren’t relevant, and of course it’s on github, so I’m not trying to remember what some bullet point used to say, or sifting through 10 versions of the same document.
